name: companion-page
description: Offline emotional companion page: Node gateway + WhisperKit helper + Bonsai (llama-server)

scripts.setup: swift build -c release --package-path stt && node server/main.js --warm-only
scripts.test: mkdir -p test-results && COMPANION_URL=${COMPANION_URL:-http://127.0.0.1:4400} node --test --test-reporter=spec --test-reporter-destination=stdout --test-reporter=junit --test-reporter-destination=test-results/junit.xml tests/mood.test.js tests/fake-companion.test.js tests/client.test.js tests/offline.test.js tests/companion.test.js tests/wav.test.js tests/talk-button.test.js tests/health-watch.test.js tests/voice-turn.test.js tests/voice-hints.test.js tests/copy.test.js tests/verify-r1.test.js tests/fnd-r1-fix.test.js tests/verify-r2.test.js tests/copy-increment2.test.js tests/clear.test.js tests/name.test.js tests/poke.test.js tests/speaker.test.js tests/speaker-toggle.test.js tests/breath-offer.test.js tests/reduced-motion.test.js tests/fit.test.js tests/crisis-card.test.js tests/breath.test.js tests/server-unit.test.js tests/server-fakes.test.js tests/server-live.test.js
scripts.test:backend: mkdir -p test-results && node --test --test-reporter=spec --test-reporter-destination=stdout --test-reporter=junit --test-reporter-destination=test-results/junit-backend.xml tests/server-unit.test.js tests/server-fakes.test.js tests/server-live.test.js tests/server-boot.test.js
